name: onewave-skills
description: Claude Code plugins from OneWave AI's open-source skills library

plugins.name: agent-army
plugins.description: Deploy a 2-layer parallel agent hierarchy for large, parallelizable work: big refactors, multi-file migrations, codebase-wide audits, and bulk generation. Pick an army size and power level; includes git checkpoints, a pre-deploy gate, phantom-completion checks, and multi-wave follow-up.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Not sure which skill or subagent fits the task? Scout reads the conversation and recommends the best skills and subagents, explains why, and lays out how to chain them.

plugins.name: scout-pro
plugins.description: A deeper skill navigator: maps the whole conversation, verifies which skills you actually have installed, designs multi-skill chains, and keeps a local log of which recommendations worked so it gets better over time.
